limits: Already inspected during development. Publisher split unavailable; all 138 eligible images retain pooled validation diagnostics. Gates use split_of(source_id) halves, not a fresh independent held-out claim.
Partial publisher boxes establish labelled positives only. Unmatched proposals and unlabelled species are unassessed; no precision or false-alarm rate is supported.
All decoded-pixel aliases are quarantined, including conflicting annotation aliases. An image with any invalid source box is withheld whole; no clipping or label union.
Box matching is one-to-one maximum cardinality at IoU >=0.5 in the first 100 retained SAM3 proposals. Boxes do not establish individual plant or mask accuracy.
Region and image-species-pair Wilson intervals ignore dependence within photographs. No independently established site split or pretraining exclusion. ImageWeeds is CC BY 4.0.

Conditional identification excludes localization misses; localized_and_identified keeps every labelled box in the denominator. Image-species pairs count each taxon once per photo. Both aggregation policies are descriptive development comparisons.

BioClipClassifier uses a fixed NZ watchlist vocabulary with none of the five ImageWeeds taxa; it cannot measure their species identity. PlantCLEF uses its complete vocabulary. Scores are uncalibrated, not presence probabilities.

configuration.operating_points: Frozen before this port; no threshold or budget tuning
configuration.gate_split_policy: split_of(source_id); pooled validation rows are diagnostic
configuration.gate_rule: 95% development Wilson bound widened by expected held-out Wilson half-width
configuration.proposal_order: prompt order then descending concept score; no cross-prompt suppression
configuration.source_crop_control: floor/ceil source box, original tight centre-crop
configuration.region_crop: pipeline masked view, max side 1024, neutral square padding
configuration.species_policies: frequency and max_score, same five-slot budget
